_readme: Ground truth for retrieval evaluation. Each case names a query and the
concepts a correct retriever should return.
'relevant' uses concept NAMES, not ids. Ids are derived from the match key
and are reassigned whenever normalization changes (enabling semantic fusion
rewrites all of them), which would silently invalidate every case. Names and
aliases are resolved at evaluation time; anything unresolvable is reported
rather than scored as a miss.
Cases are hand-written against concepts that exist in this corpus, NOT
generated from the concept text — generating queries from the same text the
concepts were embedded from would inflate semantic retrieval.
'paraphrase' cases should share as little vocabulary as possible with the
target concept: that is what separates lexical from semantic and graph
